## How Water Heater Leak Repair Works
First shut off the cold water inlet and the power or gas to the heater. A technician then traces the leak, repairs fittings or valves where possible and checks water pressure and expansion control. If the tank itself leaks, they will provide replacement options and can often install the same day.

## Water Heater Leak Repair Cost in Anaheim
Fitting and valve repairs are usually modest. Water damage cleanup and tank replacement raise the total, so acting quickly keeps costs down.

## Repair or Replace?
Leaks from the tank body cannot be repaired. Leaks from valves, connections or the relief valve often can.

The technician tests the thermostat, heating elements and high-limit switch, confirms wiring and replaces failed components. They set the temperature to a safe level and verify that it holds, typically around 120 degrees Fahrenheit for most households.

The technician relights the pilot following manufacturer procedures, checks flame quality, cleans the pilot assembly, tests and replaces the thermocouple or thermopile if needed, and confirms the burner and venting are working. They also inspect the gas control valve and check for gas leaks.

Cleaning or replacing the thermocouple is usually a low-cost repair. Gas control valve replacement costs more.
